text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri holds news conference after unanimous 'yes' vote in referendum on constitutional reform.
- President of Parliament Jalal Essaid says after release of referendum results: a new era has begun.
- Schools reopen while there is no national vision of reform.
- Government to look at new laws shaping parliament's split into two chambers.
- After massive approval of constitutional revision, the countdown has begun for legislative elections.
- Driss Basri says: massive 'yes' vote reflects national consensus.
